title.en: The land, the five regions and the capital
title.fr: Le territoire, les cinq régions et la capitale

text.en: The border between Canada and the United States runs along Canada's southern edge.
text.fr: La frontière entre le Canada et les États-Unis longe la limite sud du Canada.

source.quote: Along the southern edge of Canada lies the Canada-United States boundary.

verification.evidence: Along the southern edge of Canada lies the Canada-United States boundary.

text.en: Canada and the United States have both promised to keep their shared border safe, secure and efficient.
text.fr: Le Canada et les États-Unis se sont tous deux engagés à garder leur frontière commune sûre, sécuritaire et efficace.

source.quote: Both Canada and the U.S.A. are committed to a safe, secure and efficient frontier.

verification.evidence: Both Canada and the U.S.A. are committed to a safe, secure and efficient frontier.

text.en: Canada's regions are the West Coast, the Prairie Provinces, Central Canada, the Northern Territories and the Atlantic Provinces.
text.fr: Les régions du Canada sont la Côte Ouest, les provinces des Prairies, le Centre du Canada, les territoires du Nord et les provinces de l'Atlantique.

source.quote: • The Atlantic Provinces • Central Canada • The Prairie Provinces • The West Coast • The Northern Territories

verification.evidence: The Regions of Canada Canada includes many different geographical areas and five distinct regions. • The Atlantic Provinces • Central Canada • The Prairie Provinces • The West Coast • The Northern Territories

text.en: Ottawa sits inside the National Capital Region, an area of 4,700 square kilometres. The region protects and improves the older buildings and the natural setting around the city.
text.fr: Ottawa se trouve au cœur de la région de la capitale nationale, un territoire de 4 700 kilomètres carrés. La région protège et met en valeur le patrimoine bâti et le milieu naturel des environs.

source.quote: The National Capital Region, 4,700 square kilometres surrounding Ottawa, preserves and enhances the area’s built heritage and natural environment.

verification.evidence: The National Capital Region, 4,700 square kilometres surrounding Ottawa, preserves and enhances the area’s built heritage and natural environment.

text.en: Most people in Canada live in cities. Others live in small towns, in country areas, and everywhere in between.
text.fr: La plupart des gens au Canada habitent en ville. D'autres vivent dans de petites villes, à la campagne et partout entre les deux.

source.quote: While the majority live in cities, Canadians also live in small towns, rural areas and everywhere in between.

verification.evidence: While the majority live in cities, Canadians also live in small towns, rural areas and everywhere in between.
